people.name: Horonaim
people.line: A Moabite city mentioned in prophecies of judgment

translations.web: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!
translations.bsb: A voice cries out from Horonaim: ‘Devastation and great destruction!’
translations.kjv: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.
